offering_description.value: Holds stakes in independent investment management firms and supports them with capital, distribution and operations. Sells investment management services to institutional and individual investors through these affiliates, earning fees on assets managed.

primary_products.value: mutual funds; separate accounts; alternative investment funds; wealth management portfolios

primary_services.value: investment management; investment advisory; wealth management; distribution support

customer_segment.value: B2B: pension funds, endowments, foundations, insurers, sovereign and corporate institutions; B2C: individual and high-net-worth investors served through affiliate wealth management firms; B2G: public pension plans and other government retirement systems

end_markets.value: asset management; retirement savings; wealth management; financial services

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: asset-based management and advisory fees, and performance fees, paid by funds and clients for investment management

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes in client capital and invests it through affiliate managers, selling investment products to institutions and individuals

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions through affiliate firms

specialization.value: diversified: multiple affiliate firms running equity, fixed income, alternatives and multi-asset strategies for different clients

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: affiliate institutional sales teams selling to pensions and endowments; partners / resellers: financial advisers, wirehouses and wealth platforms that place client assets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: affiliates are registered investment advisers and broker-dealers overseen by the SEC, FINRA and foreign regulators

notes: Affiliate lineup and ownership stakes change over time, so the affiliate mix may differ from current filings.
